title: NAFEMS LE1 elliptic membrane with 2D plane stress elements (quad8)
source: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, October 1990, test LE1 (target σ_yy = 92.7 MPa at D); as reproduced in the Abaqus 2017 Benchmarks Guide, 'LE1: Plane stress elements—elliptic membrane'

quantities.reason: the target is published to three figures; the stress extrapolated to the edge on a converged mesh adds a few tenths of a percent
